past_scope: Actual Standard past-source candidates only; formal past membership/edition weights and CN timing remain unverified. No production past or ordinary domain bound.

face.name: 鹿角小飞兔
face.text: 战吼：召唤一个本随从的复制。
face.flavorText: 学园的学生在美酒节玩得实在是太过分了。

face.name: Wolpertinger
face.text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this.
face.flavorText: Scholomance student Brewfest prank gone awry.

face.name: 凶猛的聒噪怪
face.text: 在本随从攻击一方英雄后，将一张它的复制置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 肯定不是有文化的聒噪怪。

face.name: Feral Gibberer
face.text: After this minion attacks a hero, add a copy of it to your hand.
face.flavorText: It's certainly not civilized gibbering.

face.name: 萨隆铁矿监工
face.text: 亡语：为你的对手召唤一个0/3并具有嘲讽的自由的矿工。
face.flavorText: 不要妄想放风的机会。

face.name: Saronite Taskmaster
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 0/3 Free Agent with Taunt for your opponent.
face.flavorText: Don't even think of asking for time off.

face.name: 当日渔获
face.text: 突袭。战吼： 为你的对手召唤一只2/1的鱼虫。
face.flavorText: 这么大的鱼，真是好辐气！

face.name: Catch of the Day
face.text: Rush Battlecry: Summon a 2/1 Worm for your opponent.
face.flavorText: Only its fish mother thinks it's a catch.

face.name: 派对邪犬
face.text: 战吼：召唤两只1/1的邪能兽。对你的英雄造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 布吉舞怪兽的主要竞争对手。

face.name: Party Fiend
face.text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Felbeasts. Deal 3 damage to your hero.
face.flavorText: Arch-rival of the Boogiemonster.

face.name: 盘桓僵尸
face.text: 亡语：召唤一个1/1并具有“亡语：召唤一个1/1的僵尸”的徒手僵尸。

face.name: Lingering Zombie
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Disarmed Zombie with "Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Zombie."

face.name: 跳虫
face.text: 战吼：召唤一个1/1的跳虫。
face.flavorText: 本来玩得好好的，2分钟一到，8只这东西冲到了你家门口。

face.name: Zergling
face.text: Battlecry: Summon a 1/1 Zergling.
face.flavorText: It's all fun and games until 8 of these show up at your door at the 2 minute mark.

face.name: 迅猛龙宝宝
face.text: 亡语：将一张4/5的“迅猛龙头领”洗入你的 牌库。
face.flavorText: 等它咬掉你的手指时，你就不会觉得它可爱了。

face.name: Raptor Hatchling
face.text: Deathrattle: Shuffle a 4/5 Raptor into your deck.
face.flavorText: They’re just baby teeth. Lots and lots of baby teeth.

face.name: 精魂狱卒
face.text: 战吼：将两张灵魂残片洗入你的牌库。
face.flavorText: “当然了，它们确实被关在你的牌库里。但思想，才更像是真正的监牢。”

face.name: Spirit Jailer
face.text: Battlecry: Shuffle 2 Soul Fragments into your deck.
face.flavorText: "Sure, they're in your deck, but the mind is like, the REAL prison."

face.name: 列车机务工
face.text: 亡语：获取一张淤泥桶。有毒废弃物：请妥善处理。
face.flavorText: 头戴淤泥眼镜，笑看多彩人生。

face.name: Tram Mechanic
face.text: Deathrattle: Get a Barrel of Sludge. TOXIC WASTE: Handle with care.
face.flavorText: He looks at life through sludge-tinted glasses.

face.name: 奇迹推销员
face.text: 亡语：获取一张可交易的蛇油。
face.flavorText: “嗨！你好啊亲！你想创业自己当老板吗？”

face.name: Miracle Salesman
face.text: Deathrattle: Get a Tradeable Snake Oil.
face.flavorText: "Hey! Hope you’re well. Have you ever wanted to be your own boss?"

face.name: 青玉游荡者
face.text: 潜行，亡语：召唤一个 的青玉魔像。 潜行，亡语：召唤一个青玉魔像。
face.flavorText: 所到之处，寸草不生。

face.name: Jade Swarmer
face.text: Stealth Deathrattle: Summon a Jade Golem. Stealth Deathrattle: Summon a Jade Golem.
face.flavorText: He's so good at swarming, he can swarm all by himself!

face.name: 活泼的松鼠
face.text: 亡语：将四张橡果洗入你的牌库。当抽到橡果时，召唤一只2/1的松鼠。
face.flavorText: 别看它们现在萌萌的，等你听到野蛮咆哮，就晚了。

face.name: Vibrant Squirrel
face.text: Deathrattle: Shuffle 4 Acorns into your deck. When drawn, summon a 2/1 Squirrel.
face.flavorText: Oh, they're cute now. Just wait till they unleash a Savage Roar.

face.name: 徒手僵尸
face.text: 亡语：召唤一个1/1的僵尸。

face.name: Disarmed Zombie
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Zombie.

face.name: 自由的矿工
face.text: 嘲讽

face.name: Free Agent
face.text: Taunt

face.name: 灵魂残片
face.text: 抽到时施放 为你的英雄恢复 2点生命值。

face.name: Soul Fragment
face.text: Casts When Drawn Restore 2 Health to your hero.

face.name: 淤泥桶
face.text: 当本牌被使用，弃掉或摧毁时，对生命值最低的敌人造成 4点伤害。

face.name: Barrel of Sludge
face.text: When this is played, discarded, or destroyed, deal 4 damage to the lowest Health enemy.

face.name: 蛇油
face.text: 可交易 造成 0点伤害。好像没什么用……

face.name: Snake Oil
face.text: Tradeable Deal 0 damage. This seems useless...

face.name: 橡果
face.text: 抽到时施放 召唤一只2/1的 松鼠。

face.name: Acorn
face.text: Casts When Drawn Summon a 2/1 Squirrel.
